policy: User-authorized editorial cursor/halo/ripple overlays and locally synthesized interaction cues. The approved montage, scene timing and original music arrangement remain; guided video frames and audio are intentionally NOT byte-identical. No fabricated interactions, progress stages, success notices or latency claims.

alignment.method: Inspected native 25 fps source frames with PTS labels, matched visible state changes and focused/pressed controls to the actual recording script. Independently compared decoded 160x90 grayscale UI crops in the approved montage against source frames before/after transitions (MSE normally 0.02-0.32 at matching frames). Wall-clock milestones were only search hints, NOT frame offsets.
alignment.precision: Cue timestamps are selected native frame PTS, not measured mouse-down telemetry. Each click has an observed transition bracket. Coordinates are the target center measured in the visible source UI, not a claim of the unrecorded original cursor trajectory. No interpolated cursor travel between actions.

evidence.observed: Transcribir button becomes Procesando and the page scrolls. Overlay stops before the button relocates.
Only the genuinely visible processing interval is pulsed. The focus encloses existing stages without changing them. No completion sound or new success UI.
Traducción (ES) becomes the active tab and Spanish lines appear.
Vista dual becomes active and paired source/translation lines appear.
Programmatic keyboard focus and typing, NOT a click. Focus outline only, no cursor/ripple/click audio.
Search clears programmatically at 25.48; only then is the 00:05 target present. The second line highlights at 25.52. No pointer is shown before the target exists.
Reading layout replaces normal layout; pointer stops at the layout change.
Normal layout returns; pointer stops before the exit button disappears.
TXT control focuses; recording checks confirm its real download. No added download-success notice.
SRT pressed/focus state and confirmed real download.
VTT control focuses; recording checks confirm its download.
MD control focuses; recording checks confirm its download.
First-line image button highlights and the recorded application shows its own toast. We add no success UI and do not assert a separately verified image download.
Nueva transcripción returns to the form. Pointer ends before the link disappears.
Existing Me at the zoo history card presses and result returns. No new production transcription was requested.
Reopened Transcripción tab is visible at 35.92; recorded second Vista dual click switches it at 35.96.

limitations: 14 click cues correspond only to explicit click() actions visible in the recording; no language-selection, URL-entry, search-field or clear-field click is invented.
The loading pulse is editorial ambience during the real wait, not an application notification or progress measurement.
Original scene cards and subtitle timings remain unchanged even when narration boundaries do not coincide with action frames.
The historical baked-in Sin audio footer describes the originally silent capture; the guided edition has optional original music and editorial cues.
Source artifacts remain private/local and are not copied into the public directory. Reproduction uses the pinned approved music backup plus this inspected ledger.
